messages:
mia_cs: Heads-up — AcmeCorp asked for field-level pseudonymization examples, sample export logs, and a copy of our SOC2 dataflow. Feels like scope creep. @natalie_security @aj_kapoor can you weigh in?

aj_kapoor: Probably scope creep. We should avoid sending raw logs. Offer redacted/synthetic logs + a high-level diagram and an attestation. Ask why they need export logs vs an attestation.

natalie_security: +1. Do not share PII. Offer: (1) synthetic CSV sample, (2) schema mapping showing pseudonymization fields, (3) region-level residency statement. Also confirm retention window they're checking.

sam_engineer: If they want a sample export, we can produce a tiny synthetic CSV. Example: 
```csv
user_id,pseudonym_id,event,timestamp
U-REDACTED,PS-123,login,2025-11-01T12:34:56Z
```
Use this + a short note explaining it's synthetic.

mia_cs: Nice. @hannah_legal can legal bless the attestation language for synthetic samples?

hannah_legal: We can sign off on a one-paragraph attestation. Suggested language: "The attached samples are synthetic and contain no customer or personal data; they are provided for informational purposes only." If they mention key provenance or BYOK, ask for specific clause reference in their DPA.

natalie_security: Also clarify SOC2 scope: are they validating our control presence (processes) or actually verifying exported data? If the latter, escalate and require non-disclosure agreement + security review.

mia_cs: Drafting clarifying questions now: "Can you confirm purpose for export logs and whether synthetic/redacted samples are acceptable? Please confirm the retention window and the exact SOC2/DPA clause you are evaluating"

forms-bot: Intake form created: ID 8921 — https://redwood.example/intake/8921 :page_with_curl: 

aj_kapoor: Internal note: tag intake as SENSITIVE if they explicitly request logs, otherwise STANDARD. Keeps routing clear.

hannah_legal: Also ask customer to cite the DPA or vendor-form section (e.g., Section 3.2) they reference — makes mapping much faster.

mia_cs: I'll send the clarifying message and include the synthetic CSV + the attestation draft once legal approves.

sam_engineer: I'll also create a 1-page dataflow diagram stub (PNG) using the internal diagrams script. Quick command I used: `python diagrams/mk_dataflow.py --service redwood-inference --output acmecorp_stub.png` — will drop link here when ready.

mia_cs: ETA for the PNG? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

sam_engineer: Later today, will post PNG + legend.

aj_kapoor: If they push for raw exports, escalate immediately to Natalie + Hannah — do not provide.

mia_cs: Thanks team. Sending clarifying Qs now and will paste legal-approved attestation + synthetic sample back into this thread when received.

(ending note) mia_cs: closing loop — will update upon customer reply.
